steps.text: A git push to GitLab triggers the pipeline.
The self-hosted GitLab Runner on EC2 builds and packages the app.
The artifact is uploaded to an S3 bucket.
CodeDeploy pulls the artifact from S3 and starts a blue/green deployment.
A green fleet is provisioned by copying the Auto Scaling Group.
The Application Load Balancer shifts traffic from blue to green.
After a successful deployment the blue fleet is terminated (0-minute wait).
